players.note: Torn UCL and elbow surgery; expected to miss the 2027 season

lottery._note: Non-playoff teams, worst 2026 record first, with base No. 1 pick odds (%). Giants and Pirates are ineligible (revenue-sharing rule) and cannot pick higher than 10th; their odds are removed and the rest scale up (so the top three show 19.1%). Slots 1-13 confirmed from published odds; 14-18 are estimates (sources unreachable from the build machine).

playoff._note: Picks 19-30 by round of elimination, then record. 2026: Brewers beat Rays in the World Series; LCS losers Guardians, Dodgers; DS losers White Sox, Padres, Braves, Yankees; Wild Card losers Red Sox, Astros, Phillies, Cubs. Astros and Braves records not confirmed, so their place inside the group is an estimate.

cbt_drop._note: Clubs $40M+ over the 2026 tax threshold: first pick moves back 10 spots unless it is a top-6 lottery pick. All five are $40M+ over the $244M line in Roster Resource's 2026 luxury-tax payrolls (LAD 422, NYM 358, NYY 336, PHI 324, TOR 315); final once MLB issues the bills in December.

cb._note: Competitive Balance rounds flip each year; projected from the 2026 groups (official list comes in December). Ordered worst record first.
